reports.label: NYCE Frustrated
reports.description: Pulls the full NYCE call population, keeps any call that matched a frustration phrase or scored at or below -1.2 sentiment.

reports.label: Agent Response Delay
reports.description: Find calls where the agent does not speak within a configurable number of seconds from the start of the call.

reports.label: WGS Transcripts
reports.description: Paste pairs of key value and minimum date. Runs one search across the selected range and keeps only calls strictly after each row's paired threshold.
